column1: # Hand-curated POS mapping for CMUdict words whose variants differ in primary stress (spec 06, Open question 1).
# Drafted from the usual English pattern: noun and adjective stress the first syllable, verb the second.
# Values are the 1-based syllable that carries primary stress for that part of speech; "-" means the pattern
# doesn't hold (or both are common), so the word stays expectedAmbiguous for that part of speech.
# Only words that tools/gen_stress_shift_pairs.py lists may appear here; the generator fails otherwise.
# CPO can review every row; changing a row means re-running the generator (python3 tools/gen_stress_shift_pairs.py).
